notes:
{輪|わ} refers to circular shapes like rings, circles, wheels, and loops.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{車輪|しゃりん}→車輪：04198_sharin⟧: wheel (vehicle)
- ⟦{指輪|ゆびわ}→指輪：01744_yubiwa⟧: ring (jewelry)
- ⟦{首輪|くびわ}→首輪：14637_kubiwa⟧: collar (for pets)
- ⟦{輪ゴム|わごむ}→輪ゴム：20399_wagomu⟧: rubber band
- ⟦{浮|う}き{輪|わ}→浮き輪：09261_ukiwa⟧: swimming float, life ring
- ⟦{花輪|はなわ}→花輪：23837_hanawa⟧: wreath

- {輪|わ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to form a circle
- {輪|わ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make a circle
- {輪|わ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧: to expand the circle/network
- {輪|わ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加|くわ}わる→加わる：01940_kuwawaru⟧: to join the circle
